column1: The battery life is excellent and easily lasts two full days of heavy use.
Camera quality is brilliant, portraits come out sharp even at night.
The display is gorgeous and bright enough to use under direct sunlight.
Performance is smooth, gaming runs without a single stutter.
Build quality feels premium and the phone looks stunning.
Delivery was fast, arrived a day earlier than expected.
Speaker loudness is impressive for phone speakers.
Value for money is outstanding at this price point.
Sound quality during calls is crisp and clear.
Overall this is the best phone I have owned in years.
